groups.name: Masca + Teide VIP
groups.desc: Discover the north of Tenerife on an exclusive tour through Masca and the Teide National Park, perfect for those seeking breathtaking views and comfort. Travel in a 4x4 minivan with air conditioning and only eight passengers to enjoy this VIP experience. Start with pickup from your accommodation or a nearby point, heading to unique places like San Pedro Viewpoint and Garachico, a town rebuilt after a volcanic eruption in the 18th century. Stop in Masca, one of Tenerife's most charming villages, known for its historic rural houses. Here, you’ll enjoy Canarian cuisine with traditional dishes. Finally, explore the Teide National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, where you'll discover the colors of Pico Viejo and the iconic Roques de García. End the tour in La Orotava, admiring its colonial architecture, and take home an unforgettable experience of authentic Tenerife.

groups.name: La Laguna + Anaga VIP
groups.desc:
Discover two of the most fascinating sides of Tenerife with this VIP Tour through Anaga and La Laguna, possibly two of the island's most authentic landmarks. Do it comfortably aboard a four-wheel-drive and air-conditioned minivan, with a maximum of eight people.

After pickup, the van will head to San Cristóbal de La Laguna, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that combines traditions, legends, and beauty in every corner. Learn everything about this unique town with the explanations of the Tamarán team, who will also take you on an excursion to Anaga. A volcanic formation between 7 and 9 million years old. It boasts the world’s most important laurel forest, dragon trees, and cardón plants, and with every step you will feel more and more part of a truly magical atmosphere.

This VIP Tour through Anaga and La Laguna leaves nothing behind: it also takes you to Santa Cruz or for lunch in Taganana, where you can taste Canarian gastronomy: it has it all! Embark on this comfortable four-wheel adventure and feel what it's like to be part of the north.

groups.name: Vuelta a La Isla VIP
groups.desc:
Immerse yourself in everything that makes Tenerife special and unique with a VIP Tour designed for you to take the best of the island in the form of stories, photos, and fascinating information.

The route begins at your accommodation or a nearby point, where a spacious minivan will pick you up, with a maximum of 8 people.

After pickup, the adventure begins, taking you to places such as Masca with its classic hamlets, Garachico, a town that rose from its ashes even more beautiful after being destroyed by a volcano in the 18th century, the Thousand-Year-Old Dragon Tree in Icod, and the Teide National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Enjoy dreamlike views throughout the route and listen to everything we share during the stops. During the day, there will be a stop at a restaurant in La Orotava, where you can taste some of the finest delights of Canarian gastronomy.

groups.name: Gomera VIP Tour
groups.desc:
Discover the luxury of visiting such a wonderful island as La Gomera aboard one of Tamarán’s spacious minivans, designed to make your VIP Tour to La Gomera unforgettable. Let the team tell you everything about what you visit and immerse yourself fully in an island that was the prelude to the discovery of America by Christopher Columbus.

This tour takes you from your accommodation — or a nearby point — to the places that make this island so special, which proudly has its own language, the Gomero Whistle (Silbo Gomero), declared World Heritage. If you want to learn all about it, don't miss the explanations from Tamarán’s team, who will turn your VIP Tour into a journey full of history.

Begin your trip by ferry in style: with an open bar of food and drinks while you enjoy the breeze and the best views of the Atlantic. When you reach San Sebastián de La Gomera, just like Columbus did over 500 years ago, your route will take you to dreamlike places such as a traditional pottery center, the Vallehermoso viewpoint, the Garajonay National Park with its laurel forests, or the Abrante viewpoint, where you’ll enjoy a special meal while tasting Canarian delicacies.

This excursion includes a stop at a typical restaurant where you’ll savor some of the most characteristic dishes of the islands’ gastronomy.

groups.name: Teide Tour VIP
groups.desc:
If what you want is to exclusively enjoy the Teide National Park in a big way and only with your friends, without anyone else, discovering all the corners of one of the most visited National Parks in the world, Teide VIP Tour is the excursion you and your friends are looking for.

On this Teide tour, you’ll enjoy 8 hours of truly spectacular volcanic landscapes.

You’ll also discover the volcanoes that caused the most recent eruptions in Tenerife and learn about the history of how the Canary Islands were formed.

Surely after this group tour, you and your friends can play a mini-Teide trivia game!

The Teide Tour does not include lunch, although your group will have free time to eat calmly and talk about how much fun you’re having!

groups.name: Teide de Noche VIP
groups.desc:
Enjoy exclusive access to witness the transformation of Teide National Park at sunset and be amazed by the starry sky, one of the purest on the planet.

In this VIP experience, you will explore the different ecosystems of the Park on a private and comfortable ascent, from rural landscapes and laurel forests to the high mountain, home to unique species such as broom and rosalillo de cumbre. Along the way, you will discover little-known natural secrets, such as volcanic tunnels that host creatures adapted to darkness and discreet native bats flying through the night.

As night falls, the sky of Teide becomes an unrivalled stage: under a crystal-clear atmosphere, free from light pollution, you will have the chance to admire 83 of the 88 known constellations, planets, clusters, and distant galaxies. All accompanied by your private Starlight guide, who will reveal myths, curiosities, and mysteries of the cosmos, while you enjoy personalised attention.

The observation will take place in a unique location, the base station of the cable car, at 2,356 metres above sea level, with professional long-range telescopes at your disposal. On full moon nights, you will discover in detail the fascinating lunar geography, as if walking on its surface.

An exclusive, intimate, and sophisticated journey that combines the best of nature, astronomy, and the pleasure of travelling in style.

groups.name: Astronomic Tour VIP
groups.desc:
This excursion is designed for true astronomy enthusiasts who wish to enjoy personalized attention, without rush, and in an intimate atmosphere.

You will begin the experience at the Teide Observatory, with a private guided visit in the afternoon. Your Starlight guide, an expert in night-sky observation, will explain in a close and engaging way the importance of the Canary skies, how the telescopes work, and the most outstanding projects of the Canary Islands Astrophysics Institute. You will also observe the sun as never before, discovering sunspots and flares through a specialized telescope.

Afterwards, you will enjoy a unique sunset from the Observatory itself, where the sun hides behind majestic Mount Teide and the sky is painted with colors illuminating the volcano and the ocean.

At nightfall, we will move to the base of the Teide Cable Car, far from any light pollution. There you will take part in an exclusive astronomical observation, both with the naked eye and through long-range telescopes. From this privileged spot, 83 of the 88 officially recognized constellations can be observed.

You will discover stars, planets, galaxies, and clusters as never before, while your guide teaches you to interpret the celestial map and shares with you fascinating facts about the universe. An unrepeatable experience in one of the most spectacular national parks on the planet.

groups.name: VIP Ascent to the Peak on foot
groups.desc:
Your guided climb to Teide summit with your own private guide begins at Montaña Blanca at 2,320 m.

What can you expect from this route to the Teide crater?


	You’ll begin the route on paths of pumice stone and lava; a low gradient ascending walk that lasts an hour and a half.
	The path narrows and a there’s a slight incline before you reach the Altavista Refuge at 3,260 m.
	There you will take a rest to eat and let your bodies adapt to the pressure and climate.
	You will continue on paths of solidified lava until you reach the Teide Cable Car station (3,550 m).
	You will behold some spectacular views of the Teide National Park and the island of Tenerife from the cable car upper station.
	​


The climax of your epic ascent on foot to the peak of Teide with your own private guide is the final stretch to the Teide crater.

The ascent will be much harder but the reward will be worth it.

After the final effort you’ll enjoy time to relax and take in the magnificent panoramic views of the Canary Archipelago from an altitude of 3,718 m.

groups.name: Tenerife VIP Tour
La Gomera Vip
groups.desc:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure and dive into the essence of La Gomera, the hidden gem of the Canary Islands. In a small group of maximum 18 people, you’ll explore spectacular landscapes, ancient forests, and picturesque villages that preserve the island’s most authentic character.

From San Sebastián de La Gomera, a town full of history and charm, to the stunning viewpoints of Roque de Agando and Valle Gran Rey, every corner of the island will amaze you with its natural beauty. Enter the Garajonay National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, where the laurel forest wraps the landscape in a magical and mysterious atmosphere. You'll visit Chipude and El Cercado, known for their pottery tradition, and have the chance to discover the Silbo Gomero, a unique whistled language recognized by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

During the tour, you’ll enjoy the peaceful charm of small towns like Igualero, the highest village on the island, and immerse yourself in the history and culture of this Canarian jewel. You’ll also have the option to taste the island’s delicious cuisine, with typical products such as almogrote, gofio, and palm honey.

This excursion includes everything you need for a carefree experience: an official Canary Islands guide, ferry tickets, and comfortable transport in an air-conditioned bus. Just relax and let yourself be swept away by the magic of La Gomera.

Don’t miss the chance to discover this fascinating island in an exclusive and personal way. Book now and get ready for a journey you’ll never forget.

303.faq:
Included: 


	Special permit from the Park for the whole group to access the Teide crater.
	A private group guide in Spanish, English or German.
	Teide Cable Car ticket for the descent.
	Transfer from the southern and northern parts of Tenerife.


Meal not included.

Important: the price includes a private tour for 2 people. If you want to add more people to your group, you must select the option ''Extra Person" and add it to the basket.
Maximum of 8 people per group.

Do not hesitate to contact us to help you organize your VIP group activity.

Restrictions:


	Children under 14, pregnant women and people with heart problems are not allowed to participate in this activity.
	The ascent to the peak on foot is not recommended for people with reduced mobility or injuries.
	People with health problems should consult with their doctors before undertaking this hike.
	In accordance with current regulations, persons with any physical disability or motor impairment are not permitted to make the ascent by cable car, because of the potential risks if the vehicle has to be evacuated.
	In the event of the failure of the cable car system due to unexpected technical reasons, passengers already at the upper station will have to make their descent on foot and using steep mountain paths.


Important information:


	Please be aware that the reservation of this activity will be pending confirmation until Volcano Teide have issued named access passes to the crater.
	In the event that Volcano Teide are unable to confirm the activity, they will offer you an alternative date or a refund of the amount paid.
	It is necessary to present your ID or passport at the point of access to the trail leading to the crater.
	In the event that the path to the peak is closed, Teide National Park staff may permit access only to mountaineers belonging to a federation who can provide sufficient proof of their ability, and who are appropriately equipped. It is the individual’s responsibility to ensure that they possess the appropriate documentation and equipment, therefore the absence of either exempts Volcano Teide from any liability.


Cancelations and changes:


	In the event that it is not possible to carry out the activity due to adverse weather conditions or the closure of one of the trails we usually walk during this hiking activity, Volcano Teide will cancel your hike to Teide and give you a refund of the amount paid.
	In case the weather conditions do not allow the operation of the cable car, the visit to the National Park will be made in an alternative hike. The difference between the price of the exclusive Teide Tour and the ascent to the VIP peak will be refunded. Up to a maximum of 2 people will be charged 115€ per person and 31€ for each additional person. The difference paid will be refunded. 
	In case the cable car is operational but the ascent path to the peak is closed, the visit to the National Park will be carried out with a cable car ascent to La Rambleta and an alternative hike. Up to a maximum of 2 people will be charged 147'50€ per person and 73€ for each additional person. The difference paid will be refunded. 
	If the cable car cannot be used to descend on the day of the activity due to adverse weather conditions, Volcano Teide will offer you two alternative options: descent on foot from the peak to the starting point of the Montaña Blanca trail or a shorter walk up to the Refuge only, without accessing the crater, and then descent on foot down the Montaña Blanca.
	In the event of the onset of poor weather conditions during the hike, the guide will decide whether to continue the ascent to the peak or cancel it.
	Cancellations are not admitted once the reservation is confirmed.
